query: What compute (GPUs, storage) and human-labeling estimates are typical for fine-tuning IndoBERT on ~50–200k Indonesian news items?

response.query: What compute (GPUs, storage) and human-labeling estimates are typical for fine-tuning IndoBERT on ~50–200k Indonesian news items?
response.answer: Fine-tuning IndoBERT on ~50–200k Indonesian news items typically requires a high-end GPU for computation and several weeks of human-labeling effort. Expect 1–2 Tesla V100 GPUs and 1–2 months of labeling work.
